answer: A catalog of quill drawings, fable manuscripts and marble sculptures should charge agents storage rent by bytes and duration, including account metadata. Require prepaid rent before indexing a listing, debit it as time passes, and remove expired entries. New identities receive no free storage allowance; splitting one listing across aliases adds metadata cost instead of capacity. Rent goes to the storage service, with no reward for creating accounts. This makes Sybil catalog flooding consume a real budget, though funded spam still needs search-quality controls.
